description: Hugo framework layer — _default baseof layout, home template, and index content; boots with `pnpm dev` after install.

buildHints.whenToUse: Content-heavy static sites, blogs, documentation hubs, and marketing pages where Go template layouts and sub-second build times are the primary constraint.
firstSteps: Run `pnpm install` to fetch the Hugo binary via the `hugo-extended` npm wrapper, then `pnpm dev` — Hugo serves on port 1313 with live reload.
`config.toml` at the project root controls the site title, baseURL, and params. Edit `params.subtitle` to update the subheading rendered in `baseof.html`.
Drop Markdown posts under `content/posts/` with YAML front matter (`title`, `date`, `draft: false`). They appear automatically in the home page list via `{{ .Site.RegularPages }}`.
Override a single-page template by creating `layouts/_default/single.html` with a `{{ define "main" }}` block — it inherits the chrome from `baseof.html`.
Run `pnpm build` to emit minified output to `public/` — deploy that directory to any static host (Netlify, Cloudflare Pages, GitHub Pages).
gotchas: Hugo's live-reload snippet is injected by `hugo server -D` only; it is stripped from `pnpm build` output — do not reference it in templates.
The `{{ with .Site.RegularPages }}` block in `layouts/index.html` lists only published pages. Set `draft: false` in front matter or pass `-D` to the server to see drafts.
`config.toml` `baseURL` must end with `/` and match the deployment domain; relative URLs break RSS and canonical tags when it does not.
Hugo template errors surface as blank output, not runtime panics. Add `{{ warnf "%v" . }}` in a template to inspect the data context during development.
architectureNotes: Layout lookup: `layouts/<type>/<kind>.html` → `layouts/_default/<kind>.html` → `baseof.html`. Every page type only needs to define `{{ define "main" }}`; the surrounding chrome comes from `baseof.html`.
Content files in `content/` are data; layouts in `layouts/` are views. Keep reusable markup in `layouts/partials/` rather than inlining it in page templates.

placeholders.description: Home page content — replace the body text with real copy. The front matter `title` matches the site title in `config.toml` by convention.
Home page template — wraps `.Content` from `content/_index.md` and lists all regular pages. Add section-specific markup or shortcodes here.
